title: Front matter of a definition
description: The YAML front matter of a definition (definitions/D<number>.md). The identifier is the file name. A definition has no scope fields.

name.description: A speaking name: lowercase words joined by hyphens. It may change; only the identifier counts.

status.description: planned: published and citable, binds nobody yet. active: in force. retired: the file stays.

replaced-by.description: The definition that took the place of a retired definition.
